description: Alterations including erection of dormer roof extension to main rear roof; Erection of  extension above two-storey back addition; Installation of sliding glazed doors to rear first floor, formation of first floor rear balcony with metal railing and associated staircase to rear garden.
decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - By reason of their design, scale and location, the proposed roof extensions would appear overly large and bulky and would appear to dominate the appearance of the host property. Furthermore, the roof extension over the back addition would constitute an unneighbourly form of development, appearing overbearing and would impinge on access to daylight to the harm of neighbouring occupiers.  Accordingly, the development is contrary to policies LP1, LP2, LP5 and of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) and the Housing SPD (2016).

Reason : 2 - The proposed first floor roof balcony, by reason of its positioning and size constitutes an unneighbourly form of development that would result in actual and perceived loss of privacy and noise and disturbance, to the harm of the neighbouring occupiers amenity. The proposal therefore fails to comply with policy LP2 of the WLP (2023) and guidance within the Housing SPD (2016).

Reason : 3 - In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to make available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies in the Local Plan as well as offering a full pre application advice service. However, we have been unable to seek solutions to problems as the proposal is clearly contrary to our statutory policies and negotiation could not overcome the reasons for refusal.
